text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy ran great using the "Dark 
Switch." Her urge to bite was gone. The 
way the crowd viewed her was beginning to 
change.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've chosen the GI February Stakes as my 
next goal. Upon hearing this, Biko Pegasus 
immediately declared her entry as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Compared to her true ability, the public's 
evaluation of her was still low. As a 
hero, she simply couldn't stand by and 
ignore Shinko Windy's situation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's put on a fierce battle between the 
two at the February Stakes and flip public 
opinion around.
